lead_ins: A short summary lay on the desk.
The tick of the clock was soft.
Alive and warm, the cat slept.
A seed sat in the soil.
bridging.errata: Canonical set: 9 ordered LINK-pair configs = the 8 rows of docs/TRIGRAM_BRIDGING.md read as 4 mirrored anchor-bearing pairs (row 4 corrected to LINK(TARGET, ANCHOR) LINK(DESTINATION, ANCHOR)) PLUS one spare leaf-to-leaf config LINK(DESTINATION, ANCHOR) LINK(DESTINATION, TARGET). Owner errata (2026-10-14, verbatim, re row 4): "that's an error on my part. but having a spare d->a and d->t link is good." D->T (file before delete, per the list) is the set's one anchorless link, included by design; the role audit accepts this declared leaf-to-leaf link and rejects any other anchorless LINK.
